source: Deterministic build/readiness manifest maintained in docs/build. No live monitoring, no Vercel polling, and no model/API calls are implemented by this tracker.

stewardBrief.title: Steward Production Readiness Brief
stewardBrief.summary: AbarVa has meaningful deterministic surfaces and read models, but full-system testing, live persona walks, Model Gateway wiring, evidence ledger productionization, ingestion/parsing, Vercel deployment verification, and production observability are still blockers.
stewardBrief.interpretationBasis: Static manifest composed from build-slice status, route/test presence, and explicit known deferrals. It is not a runtime monitor.
topBlockers: No automated full-flow route smoke and persona crawler gate covers the canonical founder/operator journeys.
Live Model Gateway and gateway audit trail are contract-defined but not implemented as production infrastructure.
Evidence ledger, ingestion/parsing, and production audit/governance persistence are not production-ready.
Vercel production deploy health is not polled by this tracker and must be verified manually after deploy.
Security/governance review is partial and must be completed before pilot or production readiness.
